teamDescription: We worked together on the API, infrastructure and admin panel.
spiderfinanceFeatureAccounts: Link each planned payment to the real transaction when it is paid.
spiderfinanceFeaturePlanning: Schedule recurring obligations and set how long they should repeat.
spiderfinanceFeatureForecasts: See how upcoming payments will affect your future balance.
spiderfinanceContribution: My commits include work on savings and reports, plus email features such as SMTP, verification, invitations, password recovery and actions from emails.
spiderfinanceSummary: A personal tool for planning payments, forecasting their effect on your balance and keeping control of your financial data.
spiderfinanceDescription: SpiderFinance started as a way to replace a spreadsheet with a personal finance tool of my own. Its central idea is to schedule recurring payments, forecast their effect on the future balance and connect each forecast to the real transaction once it is paid. Planning and day-to-day activity stay connected, while financial data remains under your control.
cliponomiconApiSummary: A private video platform that prepares different quality versions so a team can watch clips across devices and network conditions.
cliponomiconApiDescription: Cliponomicon is a private video platform already used by its team. When a clip is uploaded, a background worker creates versions at different quality levels for phones, limited devices and slower connections. The next version is being defined; a demo is still waiting on external requirements.
cliponomiconApiFeatureUpload: Upload clips and organize them with categories and tags; limit access to authorized users.
cliponomiconApiFeatureProcessing: Prepare multiple quality versions and thumbnails in the background, with tools to review and retry jobs.
cliponomiconApiFeaturePlayback: Watch and download clips across devices and network conditions.
cliponomiconApiFeatureAuth: Sign in with JWT or OpenID Connect, with access based on roles and video ownership.
cliponomiconApiFeatureSteam: Look up games from public Steam profiles and import categories and artwork from SteamGridDB.
cliponomiconApiFeatureBackoffice: Manage users, videos and jobs from the admin panel.
cliponomiconApiContribution: I built the backend, its Docker deployment and video processing with Redis queues and workers. I also coordinated the project and monthly sprints; my frontend work was occasional.
cliponomiconApiQuote: Upload your clips; the API handles processing and access.
spiderportfolioSummary: A visual CMS built to manage a portfolio; its next chapter has not been decided.
spiderportfolioDescription: SpiderPortfolio began as a CMS for building and managing a portfolio through a visual editor. For my current website, I chose Astro because it gave me more freedom to meet that need. The CMS still has value as a project, but I am deciding whether to archive it or turn it into something more general. It is separate from the website built with Astro.
spidertomp3Status: Stable release · Only a logo change is planned
spidertomp3Summary: Download a YouTube playlist in one go, choosing where to save it and the audio quality.
spidertomp3Description: SpiderToMP3 saves you from processing playlist links one at a time: the desktop app downloads its songs to a folder you choose and applies your selected quality options. The tricky part is handling the formats and qualities available from the source and building packages for Windows and Linux. A visual redesign is a future idea; the product remains a desktop app.
spidertomp3FeatureFormats: Choose from the quality options available for the source audio.
spidertomp3FeaturePlaylists: Process a whole playlist and save its songs to a folder you choose.
spidertomp3FeatureQueue: Save the queue, see progress for each track, and cancel, resume or retry downloads.
spidertomp3FeatureLists: Catch duplicates and import or export playlists in CSV, M3U and M3U8.
spidertomp3FeaturePodcasts: Import RSS podcasts and add tags and artwork if you want; you can also look up details on MusicBrainz.
spidertomp3FeatureUpdates: Check executable updates with SHA-256, adjust history settings and choose a light, dark or high-contrast theme.
spidertomp3Contribution: My commits include changes to the interface and queue, retries, clipboard input and drag-and-drop. They also cover privacy, tests, updates and distributing the executables.
spidertomp3ScopeNote: The app has a stable release. The only small task currently planned is changing its logo; a visual redesign is a future idea, not an implemented change or a move to a web service.
spidertomp3Quote: Download audio and pick up your queue whenever you like.
spiderawakeSummary: Abandoned project: no further development or APK work is planned.
spiderawakeDescription: SpiderAwake was an Android alarm built with Python, Kivy and Java, with challenges and mini-games to turn it off. The project is abandoned, and testing and APK generation are no longer active work.
rehuseSummary: Helps physiotherapists tailor exercises to each patient and deliver their routine as a PDF.
rehuseDescription: ReHuse supports a physiotherapist from the patient visit through to delivery of a plan: start from an exercise template, adapt it to the patient, assign the routine and generate a PDF to send by email.
rehuseContribution: I led the project and coordinated frontend and backend. I built most of the backend, including business rules, PDF generation and SMTP email. It was my first substantial project and a key experience in learning API design.
projectRehuse: An API for organizing patients, exercises and rehabilitation routines.
cliponomiconApiCardContribution: Backend, video processing and project coordination

spiderportfolioFeaturePreview: Review changes in the visual editor before publishing.
spiderportfolioFeaturePublishing: Publish a portfolio from the content managed in the CMS.
